authoritative_reason: Same goa v227 SwissProt exp+IC+TAS corpus and same democafa formula in both. They diverge only because each was propagated against a different OBO snapshot (lab releases/2026-01-23 vs knn releases/2025-07-22). The lab file is authoritative for the lab eval grid because its OBO matches datasets/bench-v1-K5/go.obo, the same ontology cafaeval propagates predictions and ground truth against; a mismatched OBO can drive IA negative or drop terms from the universe.
